metadata.title: TSMC Stock: Why Taiwan Semi’s Record Sales Isn’t Boosting AMD, Other Chip Makers<!-- --> - Barron's

content.text:
TSMC Posts Record Sales. Why AMD and Other Chip Stocks Are Falling.
The AI trade has run out of gas lately, and shares of Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Co. were summing up investors’ fatigue on Thursday.
